description: The National Silk & Rayon Mills Limited was established in 1951 and is based in Faisalabad, where its factory at Dhuddiwala on Jaranwala Road dyes, bleaches, finishes, prints and embroiders woven fabrics. It describes itself as an industrial contractor producing premium woven fabric for men's and ladies' fashion, supplying domestic and international brands in ethnic and western wear.
headOffice: House No. 8/3, Aziz Avenue, Canal Road, Gulberg V, Lahore, Pakistan
